name: read_monthly_plan
description: Read the canonical current/next month intended commitment plan across loans, SIPs, stock plans, commitments, credit cards and savings. Returns source keys, due dates and totals plus a backend-calculated salary surplus (positive) or shortfall (negative). Income amount stays masked: do not derive or disclose it. Range/missing/irregular salary yields null comparison. This is not remaining unpaid cash flow; do not sum other datasets into these totals. Get this plan before simulating adjustments.

month.description: YYYY-MM, current or next month in profile timezone.
